title: The answer every system under test returns
description: Only these fields are scored. Other fields are allowed and ignored, so later phases can add citations without changing the freeze.

abstain.description: True when the three sources do not support an answer to this question.

verdict.description: For questions that ask whether something is true. Null otherwise.

ids.description: GHSA and CVE IDs the answer relies on or lists.

value.description: A single fact as plain text: a version, a score or a severity label. Null otherwise.
